## [1.4.2](https://github.com/totto357/mini-games-patches/compare/v1.4.1...v1.4.2) (2026-10-15)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **cellsurvivor:** bypass order verification and immediately grant purchases via platSucceedCallback ([a0c793e](https://github.com/totto357/mini-games-patches/commit/a0c793e406b810cbd3940c7e2061fb33edbcbb24))

patches.name: Bypass License Check & Auto-Restore Save Data
patches.description: Bypasses pairip license check and automatically restores backup save data from external storage.

patches.name: Disable Interstitial, App Open & Banner Ads
patches.description: Bypasses interstitial, app-open and banner ads by intercepting readiness and show calls.

patches.name: Fix Native Libs & Disable Analytics
patches.description: Sets extractNativeLibs to true and adds metadata to disable Firebase/Google analytics.

patches.name: Free In-App Purchases (IAP Bypass)
patches.description: Bypasses Google Play billing dialog and immediately simulates a successful purchase.

patches.name: Instant Rewarded Ads
patches.description: Bypasses rewarded video ads and immediately grants the reward.

patches.name: Bypass Force Update
patches.description: Bypasses in-game force update check, treating app always as up-to-date.

patches.name: Bypass Native Signature & Package Verification
patches.description: Patches libappJni.so so that CheckPackageName and CheckApkSign always return 1 (success).

patches.name: Bypass PairIP License Check
patches.description: Bypasses Google Play Integrity / PairIP license check.

patches.name: Cleanup Dexopt Profiles
patches.description: Removes baseline.prof to prevent ART installation checksum mismatch warnings.

patches.name: Disable Analytics, Crashlytics & Error Toasts
patches.description: Completely disables AppsFlyer, Bugly, OnlineConfig and annoying Google Play Games network toasts.

patches.name: Fix Native Libs, Debuggable & Cleanup
patches.description: Sets extractNativeLibs and debuggable to true, and removes PairIP LicenseActivity if present.

patches.name: Free In-App Purchases
patches.description: Bypasses Google Play billing and immediately grants purchased diamonds/packs.

patches.name: Instant Rewarded Ads
patches.description: Makes rewarded videos always ready and immediately grants rewards without playing ads.

patches.name: Save Data Backup & Restore
patches.description: Automatically backs up and restores save data from Android/media directory across installs.
